Rate 0.122 50 0.061 0.964 50 0.129), drawn with a full outer box and interior horizontal AND vertical rules. Figures 7 and 8 are the only real graphics here, both Normal Q-Q scatters with axes titled 'Observed Value' and 'Expected Normal', but with DIFFERENT windows for the same test: Figure 7 runs x 0.8 to 1.4 and y -2 to 3 while Figure 8 runs x 60 to 90 and y -4 to 2. note: Twenty-five pages, 51 measured regions - 50 distinct page-plus-bbox keys, because p22 stacks two rasters of the Figure 20 plot area at one rect: 23 page-foot WeChat stamps at the identical [448.9,767.2,592.2,838.8] block, 2 more stamps FUSED into exhibits - Table 2 on p7 with 707 paths and Figure 19 on p21 with 723 - and 26 further regions, 18 of them exhibits, since the other two exhibit regions are the fused stamps above: twenty regions in all hold Figures 1 to 20 on sixteen figure rows and Tables 1, 2, 4 plus the p5 symbol list on four table rows. Nothing in this paper measures as display maths - every equation is set as text - so the exclusion list is stamps, overlay duplicates and one false positive. The exhibit side needs care in three places. First, FIVE exhibits - Figures 5, 6, 7, 8 and Table 3 - were drawn as ONE 245-path vector region on p11 that overflows the page on two sides, so those five share a single composite row. Second, five figures (11 to 15) come as raster-plus-vector overlay pairs, and in each pair the vector copy is the one carrying the caption, so five regions are excluded as duplicates; p22 additionally stacks two raster layers of the Figure 20 plot area at one rect, a grey backdrop and a coloured series layer, bitmaps. Third, Table 3 is truncated by its region: the measured box stops after seven of fifteen rows and the table's bottom rule at y555.1 falls outside every measured region. Numbering is clean - 'Figure N:' 1 to 20 and 'Table N:' 1 to 4, no gap and no repeat - although three printed lines carry two captions each. Captions are kind-driven with no exception: figures below, tables above, figure gaps 0.79 to 28.83 pt and table gaps a tight 21.39 to 21.40 pt. Citation is thin: four counted pointers, Table 1 from p8, Figure 9 from p12, Table 3 from p14 and Table 4 from p20, so sixteen exhibits are never cited; two of the four fire after their exhibit prints, giving lead_pages -1 and -3. Families: 7 line, 3 flowchart-or-schematic (Figures 2, 3 and 19's chevron schedule), 2 map-or-plan-view (Figures 1 and 10), 1 bar (Figure 9), 1 other (Figure 4's two-ring pie) and 2 composite-panel (p11's five exhibits, p21's Figures 16 and 17).
rules: Twenty of the fifty-one measured regions are exhibits, and two of those twenty carry the page-foot banner INSIDE them - Table 2 on p7 with 707 paths and Figure 19 on p21 with 723, each the 693 stamp paths plus the exhibit's own rules - so the census only closes after the fusion is found: those two pages have no region left to exclude, the other twenty-three stamps stand alone, and the [place.area_frac] of both fused rows reads high for what they actually draw.

The p11 region is the block's worst custody case: one region with 245 paths and a 0.568 area fraction carries FIVE separately captioned exhibits - the two K-S normality tables (Figures 5 and 6), the two Q-Q scatters (Figures 7 and 8) and the Health Range table (Table 3) - so [geometry.panel_count] reads 5 there and nowhere else on a figure row.

The paper measures 51 regions but only 50 distinct page-plus-bbox keys, because p22 stacks two 354x124 px rasters of the Figure 20 plot area at the identical rect [121.0,149.0,475.0,273.0] - a grey backdrop of solid 102-grey and a second layer of red, green and blue series fills, each carrying the same 3720 black pixels in the same positions; the record keys a region by page plus bbox, so those two placements share one excluded entry and [place.area_frac] is recorded once for both.

Two regions have bboxes that overflow the MediaBox and neither is clipped: p11's box runs to y -13.5 and x 627.0 on a 595.3 pt page, and p21's runs to x 977.8, yet the page render shows both drawings ending well inside the sheet with white to the edge. The oversize is form and watermark path geometry, so [place.area_frac] is 0.568 and 0.231 on drawings that physically occupy less, and a bbox is never evidence of clipping in this block.

Table 3 is the one exhibit the measurement truncates: the p11 region ends at y467.3, seven body rows into a fifteen-row table whose top rule is at y379.5, header rule at y396.1 and bottom rule at y555.1, so the last seven indicator rows and the closing rule sit outside every measured region on that page. The table is still recorded once, inside the composite row, and [geometry.printed_numbers] is true there because the cells print values.

Caption side is kind-driven with no exception: all sixteen figure captions print BELOW their drawing and all four table captions print ABOVE their grid, so [caption.position] is 'below' on every figure row and 'above' on every table row plus the uncaptioned p5 grid whose section heading ends 19.97 pt over it. Figure gaps span 0.79 pt to 28.83 pt - wide for this lane, against #271's 0.01 pt band - while the four table gaps are 21.39 to 21.40 pt, a 0.01 pt spread.

Numbering is clean and complete on both sides: 'Figure N:' for 1 to 20 with no gap, no repeat and no outside-vocabulary spelling, and 'Table N:' for 1 to 4, so [caption.numbering] is 'Figure N:' or 'Table N:' on every captioned row and 'none' only on the two rows no single caption governs - the p5 grid, whose only title is its section heading, and the p11 composite, whose five members are captioned individually.

Three caption pairs share one baseline each: p11 prints 'Figure 5' at x119.9 and 'Figure 6' at x312.6 on y98.61, 'Figure 7' at x122.2 and 'Figure 8' at x314.8 on y293.49, and p21 prints 'Figure 16' at x84.0 and 'Figure 17' at x313.0 on y180.89. Each pair is two separate text objects on a common baseline rather than one printed line, so a detector reading the layer sees either two lines - as on p11, where both pairs stay apart - or one joined string, as on p21, and [caption.verbatim] on the p21 composite quotes that joined string instead of inventing a split the page does not print.

Citation is thin: exactly FOUR counted pointers in twenty-five pages, each naming one exhibit noun on a page that decides which row it belongs to - 'Table 1' on p8, 'the following table' on p20, and 'the following ﬁgure' on p12 (spelled with an fi ligature) - so [mention.count] is 1 on four rows and 0 on the other sixteen, and sixteen exhibits are never cited at all.

[mention.lead_pages] is signed and honest because two of the four pointers fire after their exhibit prints: Table 1 is printed on p7 and cited on p8, so lead_pages is -1, and Table 3 is printed on p11 and cited on p14, lead_pages -3. Both negatives are the page difference the schema requires and neither is a data-entry error.

Bare gestures are counted for nothing: p7's 'shown below.', p21's 'out prediction results shown below:', p21's 'Here is the implementation timeline for health status:' and p8's 'The process can be described with the following graph.' all point at an exhibit but name no exhibit noun or stand on a page with two exhibits, so none of them reaches a row and [mention.style] stays empty on those rows rather than carrying a guess.

Two families divide the drawings unexpectedly: Figure 4 is a nested two-ring pie, which the closed vocabulary does not name, so [geometry.family] is 'other' with an other_note; and Figures 5 and 6 are SPSS table grids captioned as figures, while Figures 16 and 17 share one region, so two rows read 'composite-panel' and the paper's twenty printed figure numbers land on sixteen figure rows.

Legends are recorded from the crop, not from the caption: [geometry.legend] is 'inside' on Figure 10 (five country swatches at the lower left), 'below' on the p21 pair and Figure 18 (integer keys 0 to 19 under each panel), and 'none' on the thirteen other figure rows - including Figure 9, whose only key is the detached gradient ramp recorded as [geometry.colorbar], and Figure 20, whose keying is three labels printed inside the plot.

No drawing in this paper is 3D and no table is closed: [geometry.three_d] is 'no' on every figure row and [geometry.colorbar] is true on Figure 9 alone, while [table.rule_style] is 'booktabs' on Tables 1, 4 and the p5 grid - each measured from exactly 3 paths - and 'vertical-rules' on Table 2, which adds one interior vertical at x110.7 to the same three horizontals.

Printed defects sit in the data and the words rather than the typography: the fourteen percentages in Figure 4 sum to about 102.4%, the raster twin of Figure 15 is about 88 dpi, Figure 18's caption misspells 'Prediciton', Figure 20's subtitle says 2009 to 2018 over an axis ticked to 2117 and its stage label says 2068-2118 against an axis that stops at 2117, Table 2 prints 'Iodonesia' and 'United Kindom', the p5 grid prints 'ananlysis', Figure 12 captions the UK over a chart subtitled England, and Figure 19's five stages are drawn at widths unrelated to the years between them - while [geometry.data_labels] is false on every figure row except Figure 4, so no chart here prints a value on its mark.
